reviewNotes: Complete Desert Festival race-announcer and Suspicious Guy block, translated directly from English. Race state, wager, payout and sabotage meanings are preserved, as are all {0} placeholders. Racer names reproduce their comic character, while Escar-go remains unchanged because its spelling carries the original escargot/go pun. Ou Calico follows the approved glossary.

Race_Closed.source: Race Announcer: The racers need some time to prepare... Come back later!
Race_Closed.translation: Comentatorul Cursei: Concurenții au nevoie de puțin timp ca să se pregătească... Revino mai târziu!

Race_Question.source: Race Announcer: Guess the winner and receive some fabulous prizes!
Race_Question.translation: Comentatorul Cursei: Ghicește câștigătorul și primești niște premii fabuloase!

Race_Guess.source: Race Announcer: Who do you think will win?
Race_Guess.translation: Comentatorul Cursei: Cine crezi că va câștiga?

Race_Guess_Made.source: Race Announcer: {0}? Okay. Now sit back and enjoy the race!
Race_Guess_Made.translation: Comentatorul Cursei: {0}? Bine. Acum stai comod și bucură-te de cursă!

Race_Guess_Already_Made.source: Race Announcer: Let's see if {0} can pull this off!
Race_Guess_Already_Made.translation: Comentatorul Cursei: Să vedem dacă {0} va reuși!

Race_Collect_Prize_Special.source: Race Announcer: Escar-go... how?? Um...Well, here's your big payout...
Race_Collect_Prize_Special.translation: Comentatorul Cursei: Escar-go... cum de-a reușit?? Ăă... Ei bine, iată marele tău câștig...

Race_Collect_Prize.source: Race Announcer: Congratulations! Here's your prize!
Race_Collect_Prize.translation: Comentatorul Cursei: Felicitări! Iată premiul tău!

Race_Late_Guess.source: Race Announcer: Whoops. Looks like the race has already started. Try again later!
Race_Late_Guess.translation: Comentatorul Cursei: Hopa. Se pare că întrecerea a început deja. Încearcă din nou mai târziu!

Race_Ongoing.source: Race Announcer: The race is currently in progress! Let's talk later...
Race_Ongoing.translation: Comentatorul Cursei: Întrecerea este în desfășurare! Vorbim mai târziu...

Race_Ended.source: Race Announcer: The races have ended for the day. I hope you had fun!
Race_Ended.translation: Comentatorul Cursei: Cursele s-au încheiat pentru astăzi. Sper că te-ai distrat!

Race_Begin.source: The next race is about to begin...
Race_Begin.translation: Următoarea cursă este pe cale să înceapă...

Race_Comment_3.source: Such speed has rarely been seen!
Race_Comment_3.translation: Rareori s-a mai văzut o asemenea viteză!

Race_Comment_4.source: And now, the moment you've all been waiting for...
Race_Comment_4.translation: Iar acum, momentul pe care îl așteptați cu toții...

Race_Close.source: That's the last race for today. We'll see you tomorrow!
Race_Close.translation: Aceasta a fost ultima cursă de azi. Ne vedem mâine!

Race_Close_LastDay.source: And that's it for this year's races! See you next time!
Race_Close_LastDay.translation: Și cu asta se încheie cursele din acest an! Pe data viitoare!

Race_Win.source: Come by to collect your prize!
Race_Win.translation: Treci pe aici ca să-ți ridici premiul!

Racer_3.preservationReason: Escar-go is the racer's proper name and its exact spelling carries the English escargot/go visual pun used again in the special payout line.

Shady_Guy_Closed.source: Suspicious Guy: Heh... not now, kid. Come back later, and we can talk.
Shady_Guy_Closed.translation: Tipul Suspect: Heh... nu acum, copile. Revino mai târziu și putem vorbi.

Shady_Guy_Ended.source: Suspicious Guy: It's too late, kid. Come back when the races are happening.
Shady_Guy_Ended.translation: Tipul Suspect: E prea târziu, copile. Revino când au loc cursele.

Shady_Guy_Ongoing.source: Suspicious Guy: Eyes on the race, kid! We can talk later...
Shady_Guy_Ongoing.translation: Tipul Suspect: Ochii la cursă, copile! Putem vorbi mai târziu...

Shady_Guy_Late.source: Suspicious Guy: Too late, the race's started. Let's talk again later...
Shady_Guy_Late.translation: Tipul Suspect: Prea târziu, cursa a început. Mai vorbim după...

Shady_Guy_Intro.source: Suspicious Guy: Psst... Hey, kid. You been watching these races? Pretty exciting, huh?
Shady_Guy_Intro.translation: Tipul Suspect: Psst... Hei, copile. Te-ai uitat la cursele astea? Destul de palpitante, nu?

Shady_Guy_Intro_2.source: Suspicious Guy: ... Say, I got a little 'proposition' for ya.
Shady_Guy_Intro_2.translation: Tipul Suspect: ... Ia zi, am o mică „propunere” pentru tine.

Shady_Guy_Intro_3.source: Suspicious Guy: Just pick a racer, and their next race will be a real stinker... catch my drift?
Shady_Guy_Intro_3.translation: Tipul Suspect: Alege un concurent, iar următoarea lui cursă va fi un adevărat dezastru... pricepi aluzia?

Shady_Guy.source: Suspicious Guy: It'll just cost ya 1 Calico Egg. A small price to pay for the 'edge' you'll get.
Shady_Guy.translation: Tipul Suspect: Te va costa doar 1 Ou Calico. Un preț mic pentru „avantajul” pe care-l vei obține.

Shady_Guy_2nd.source: Suspicious Guy: Need my 'services'? It'll just cost ya 1 Calico Egg.
Shady_Guy_2nd.translation: Tipul Suspect: Ai nevoie de „serviciile” mele? Te vor costa doar 1 Ou Calico.

Shady_Guy_Question.source: Suspicious Guy: Alright, so who's gonna be the unlucky racer?
Shady_Guy_Question.translation: Tipul Suspect: Bun, și cine va fi concurentul ghinionist?

Shady_Guy_NoEgg.source: Suspicious Guy: Looks like you don't have any Calico Eggs, kid. Stop wastin' my time.
Shady_Guy_NoEgg.translation: Tipul Suspect: Se pare că n-ai niciun Ou Calico, copile. Nu-mi mai pierde timpul.

Shady_Guy_Selected_1.source: Suspicious Guy: {0}, huh? You got it, kid.
Shady_Guy_Selected_1.translation: Tipul Suspect: {0}, da? S-a făcut, copile.

Shady_Guy_Selected_2.source: Suspicious Guy: {0} it is. Now excuse me, I've got a phone call to make...
Shady_Guy_Selected_2.translation: Tipul Suspect: {0} să fie. Acum scuză-mă, am de dat un telefon...
